Wexoraa Infotech



Welcome to Wexoraa Infotech

We provide complete online solutions for your business.
Websites, mobile apps, web apps, CRM, SaaS, ERP, graphic
design, digital marketing, and sales leads – everything is
handled in one place.

With 2 years of experience, we have successfully completed 25

In digital marketing, we run Meta Ads and Google Ads,

delivering results. Along with that, we create posters, videos,
and also handle video shoots and editing to give full creative
support.

No matter what stage your business is in, our goal is to take it
to the next level. Every project we do is 100% designed and
developed by our own team.

Our pricing is flexible and depends on the scope and
requirements of the work, ensuring you get the best value for
your investment.

You can also take a look at our work and see the quality and
results we deliver.

We give our best — you can trust us.

Our Website Projects
Here are some of the websites we have successfully developed:

Exploring Munnar
👇
https://www.exploringmunnar.com/

A fully customized travel and tourism booking platform
designed to help users discover and book the best experiences
in Munnar. The website offers hotel reservations, cab bookings,
bike rentals, self-drive car rentals, tour itineraries, local
activities, and travel information through an intuitive user
interface. It includes a comprehensive admin panel for
managing users, hotels, bookings, activities, itineraries,
transport schedules, reports, and live updates, ensuring
seamless operations and an enhanced customer experience.

Admin Panel Features:
  ● Dashboard & Analytics
  ● User Management
  ● Hotel Management
  ● Booking Management
  ● Cab & Bike Rental Management
  ● Activities Management
  ● Itinerary Management
  ● Bus Timings Management
  ● Highlights & Live Information
  ● Reports & Analytics

● Secure Admin Login & Access Control

https://vpsinfraassociates.com/





A fully customized corporate website developed for a

showcase its services, completed projects, and business profile

Key Features:
  ● Company Profile & About Us
  ● Construction & Infrastructure Service Listings
  ● Projects Portfolio Showcase
  ● Responsive & Mobile-Friendly Design
  ● Contact & Inquiry Form
  ● WhatsApp & Call Integration
  ● Gallery & Project Highlights

● Fast Loading & Secure Performance

Intercity Riders
👇
https://intercityonewaytaxi.in/





A fully customized intercity taxi booking platform designed to
provide seamless one-way, round-trip, and airport transfer
services across Tamil Nadu. The website offers an intuitive
booking experience, transparent pricing, responsive design,
and quick inquiry options, ensuring a convenient and reliable
travel experience for customers.

Key Features:
  ● One-Way & Round Trip Booking
  ● Airport Pickup & Drop
  ● Online Booking Form
  ● Transparent Pricing
  ● WhatsApp & Call Integration

● Route & Service Information
  ● SEO Optimized Website


Covai Home Tech
👇
https://covaihometech.in/





A fully customized service-based website developed for a home
appliance repair company, offering AC, washing machine,
refrigerator, and TV repair services. The website provides clear
service information, quick contact options, online service
inquiries, and a responsive user interface to enhance customer
convenience.

Key Features:
  ● Home Appliance Repair Services
  ● AC, Refrigerator, TV & Washing Machine Services
  ● Online Service Request Form
  ● WhatsApp & Call Integration
  ● Service Area Information

● Responsive Mobile-Friendly Design
  ● Contact & Inquiry Management
  ● SEO Optimized Website
  ● Fast & Secure Performance


Gym Hack
👇
https://gymhack.in/

A fully customized product-based eCommerce website for
GymHack, designed to showcase and sell premium fitness
nutrition products such as oats and muesli. The website
includes a powerful admin panel for easy product
management, inventory updates, order tracking, customer
management, and seamless online shopping, ensuring a
smooth experience for both customers and administrators.

Integrated secure online payment system supporting multiple
payment methods, enabling customers to complete purchases
safely and conveniently with real-time payment confirmation
and seamless checkout experience

Purple Drop Taxi
👇
https://purpledroptaxi.com/





A fully customized taxi booking website developed for Purple
Drop Taxi, designed to provide a simple, reliable, and user-
friendly travel booking experience across Tamil Nadu. The
website allows customers to easily explore taxi services, check
transparent pricing, select their preferred vehicle, and submit
trip details through a convenient online booking system.

The platform supports multiple travel requirements including
one-way trips, round trips, airport pickup and drop, and
outstation travel. It is designed with a responsive and mobile-
friendly interface, clear call and WhatsApp options, and an

easy-to-use booking form to help customers plan their journeys
quickly and conveniently.


Taerg Laundry
👇
https://taerglaundry.com/





A fully customized premium laundry service website developed
for TAERG Laundry, designed to provide customers with a
simple and convenient way to access professional garment
care services. The website showcases TAERG’s specialized
cleaning solutions for everyday clothing as well as premium
garments such as silk sarees, blazers, lehengas, designer wear,
uniforms, shoes, bags, and more.

The website features an easy-to-use service booking system,
detailed service information, pickup and delivery options, and
a responsive mobile-friendly interface. It also highlights
TAERG’s advanced SoftWash wet-cleaning technology, offering

gentle and professional care for delicate and premium fabrics
while delivering a smooth digital experience from service
discovery to booking.

These projects reflect our capability in building modern, user-
friendly, and business-focused websites to different industries
and client needs.

We are also currently working on 8 website projects that are in
the development stage.

Chat Application- Mobile App

Fully customized MVP Chat Application with both Admin and
User-side functionalities, ensuring a complete and fully
functional system.

From idea to execution, we ensure every mobile app is built
with precision, innovation, and aligned with the client’s goals.

Fully customized real-time chat application developed for
secure and seamless business communication. The application
enables instant messaging, group conversations, media
sharing, notifications, and user management through a
modern, responsive, and performance-driven mobile interface.
It is designed to deliver a fast, reliable, and user-friendly
communication experience.

Features:
  ● Real-Time One-to-One Chat
  ● Group Chat & Admin Management
  ● Image, Video & Document Sharing
  ● Push Notifications
  ● User Authentication & Secure Login

● User Profile Management
  ● Active & Inactive Status
  ● Search & Contact Management
  ● Responsive Mobile UI/UX
  ● Fast, Secure & Scalable Architecture

Here Are the Results

Recent Ad Campaign Results

Here are some of the recent results from our Meta Ads
campaigns, showcasing performance in terms of reach,
engagement, and lead generation.

Our campaigns have generated consistent views ranging from
8,000 to 13,000+ per ad, with strong audience engagement and
multiple messaging conversions.

We have successfully achieved up to 21+ messaging leads from

In addition, our boosted Instagram campaigns have delivered
high engagement, including 400+ link clicks, helping businesses
attract potential customers and increase inquiries.

These results reflect our ability to create effective ad
strategies, optimize performance, and deliver measurable
outcomes for our clients.

These results demonstrate our ability to optimize campaigns
for different goals such as website traffic, calls, and direct
messaging, depending on business needs.
Google Ads

Google Ads Campaign Results

Here are some of the results from our Google Ads campaigns
for Intercity Riders and Purpledroptaxi, highlighting
performance in terms of clicks, impressions, and cost
efficiency.

Our campaigns have generated up to 674+ clicks and 5,000+
impressions within a short period, ensuring strong visibility and
traffic for the business.

We have also achieved 300+ clicks with over 2,000 impressions
in another campaign, maintaining an average cost per click
(CPC) as low as ₹22–₹28, delivering cost-effective performance.

In addition, one of our campaigns reached 24,000+ impressions
with 400+ clicks at a very low CPC of ₹13.44, showing strong
reach and optimized targeting.

Even with different budget levels, we consistently deliver
measurable results including website traffic, customer
inquiries, and brand visibility.

These results demonstrate our expertise in keyword targeting,
campaign optimization, and performance-driven advertising
strategies through Google Ads.
